semanticReview.method: Manual comparison with Taiwan MOE Hanyu Pinyin initial table and orthographic notes

findings.supports: The initial table maps ㄓ/ㄔ/ㄕ/ㄖ to zh/ch/sh/r and examples 知/蚩/詩/日; the note states zhi/chi/shi/ri use the i-final spelling.

limitations: Articulatory, aspiration, and regional variation claims were removed because the cited orthographic source does not establish them.
